description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE V (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_V PRIMARY KEY, V MEMO); INSERT rows 1, 2 and 3 with V of 50, 1000 and 2500 U+20AC (100 and 2000 bytes, single LVAL rows; 5000 bytes, chained); Close. A shared session sets row 3's 5000-byte chained value to Null with dbFailOnError (RecordsAffected read) and closes. Pages 0 (bytes 3584-3591), 1 and 42-57 are read after the create session and after the statement's session, and V's FieldSize read back. Asks what ACE writes: the row's reference, the old LVAL rows and pages, the maps.
